title: Canada's Fernandez beats Uzbekistan's Rakhimova to reach final in Japan
text:
Canada's Fernandez beats Uzbekistan's Rakhimova to reach final in Japan - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Canada's Fernandez beats Uzbekistan's Rakhimova to reach final in Japan
 Canadian Press October 31, 2026 - 1:16am Leylah Fernandez, of Canada, celebrates during a match against Mananchaya Sawangkaew, of Thailand, during the second round of the U.S. Open tennis championships Wednesday, Sept. 2, 2026, in New York. (Seth Wenig/AP) 
 Canada's Leylah Fernandez defeated Uzbekistan's Kamilla Rakhimova 7-5, 6-3 in semifinal play Saturday at the Pan Pacific Open. 
 Fernandez, from Laval, Que., needed one hour 54 minutes to complete the victory. 
 She will play the winner of the late semifinal between Russia's Diana Shnaider and Slovakia's Mia Pohankova.
 The final at the WTA 500 tournament is scheduled for Sunday.
